{{Quote|That rot-faced, son of a carrion worm. The man who set me up. Akers is his name. He would steal my food when I was in there. I want you to kill him.|[[Vermon Skeetz]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:PR" />}}
'''Akers Radch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|He brought me my meds. Thanks for not killing Akers. Sometimes I can't think right.|Vermon Skeetz, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:PR" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Akers Radch was captured by the [[Corellian slavers]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. During his captivity, he befriended with [[Vermon Skeetz]], a mentally sick man who managed to be fine as long as he took his medication.<ref name="SWG:PR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Vermon Skeetz escaped the bunker with a group of slaves led by [[Kyran Silene]] but he lost his medicine during the escape.<ref name="SWG:PR" /> A spacer later infiltrated the bunker to find evidence of the slaver operations for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:IE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Incriminating Evidence|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer met Akers Radch and explained that Vermon was experiencing a psychotic episode, ordering to assassinate Akers. Nevertheless, Radch agreed to help the spacer to retrieve Vermon's medicine.<ref name="SWG:PR" /> The spacer eventually broadcasted the slavers' records on the CorSec emergency request channels,<ref name="SWG:IE" /> leading dozens of CorSec agents to quickly move to the slaver bunker and free all the slaves.<ref name="SWG:HbtKS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Head back to Kyran Silene|Corellia}}</ref> After he escapaded the bunker, Akers brought the medicine to Vermon who quickly recovered from his crisis and apologized for his aggressive behavior.<ref name="SWG:PR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Akers Radch]]
Akers Radch was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Akers Radch was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>

Radch's appearance was randomly generated among 120 possible appearances. This included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] of either [[Gender/Legends|gender]], and male [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]. However the quest dialogues identified him as a male.<ref name="SWG:PR" />
